svg.title: One job, read four ways: the tokens an agent has to read
svg.desc: One job read four ways, in the tokens an agent has to read. The job: has antirez starred anything new on GitHub. headless-kit (github-stars): 72 tokens, 202 bytes, 0.28 s. Page text: 1,251 tokens, 17 times the kit. Browser snapshot: 7,136 tokens, 20,481 bytes, 3.9 s, 99 times the kit. The page's whole markup (the raw HTML, which browser tools do not return by default), shown for scale: 106,529 tokens, 1,480 times the kit. For 1,000 checks at USD 4 a million input tokens (the list price of Claude Opus 5.5 on 14 Nov 2026): $0.29 with the kit, $28.54 with the browser snapshot. Two Reddit jobs: the browser was blocked and read nothing; reddit-pull answered in 131 tokens (100 posts found and saved to disk) and 67 tokens (the whole thread saved to disk). Measured 14 Nov 2026 on Windows 11, Node 22.17, Playwright's headless Chromium 153, o200k_base tokeniser, one run each.
